column7: SERVERGUARD-WATCHER-1 leftover: an admin command's SQLite exclusive flock on <db>.server.lock was not watched, so deleting or replacing the sidecar mid-run let a server (or a second admin command) create a new file and start beside the command, both writing. The admin side now checks the inode every config.PinnedLockPingInterval like the server, takes LOCK_EX on the new file so a second acquisition is refused until it stops, and closes Exclusive.Lost; server/admin stops the command with exit 1 (TestAcquireDatabaseLock_SQLiteSidecarDeleted_StopsTheCommand; replaced and server-first cases in internal/serverguard/serverguard_sidecar_admin_watch_test.go).
